title: Demo: Concrete Multi-User, Folding, Hybrid KEM & FROST Bounds
description: Tighten four Lean 4 kernel-verified concrete cryptographic reduction bounds (scaled by 100): multi-user signing, polynomial folding (FRI/WHIR), hybrid PQ+Classical KEM combining, and FROST threshold Schnorr forking. Smaller verified constants strictly climb the leaderboard. DEMO TRACK: the loss functions in Spec.lean are illustrative polynomials named after real protocols; they are not derived from published security reductions, and scores here are not real security bounds.

tasks.title: Minimize C in 100*multiUserLoss(u,q) <= C*(u+q)^2
tasks.description: Tighten claimedMultiUserFactor (baseline 1000, sharp optimum 150) with a Lean 4 proof using 0 sorry and 0 custom axioms.

tasks.description: Tighten claimedFoldingFactor (baseline 1600, sharp optimum 350) for r-round degree-d folding soundness with 0 sorry and 0 custom axioms.
